text:
incident-bot: Pager: latency regression detected — p50 steady, p95 jumped from ~220ms -> ~1.1s across us-east-1 prod. Alert group: inference-serving-high-p95 :rotating_light:

oncall_jamie: acked. I'm on it. grabbing traces and a customer impact snapshot.

sre_maya: i'm pulling p95 by model and route now. early hint: majority from /v1/generate for long-context models.

eng_runtime_lee: any recent deploys or infra changes in us-east-1?

support_ana: we have 3 customers reporting slow responses in the last 5m (IDs redwood-enterp-12, scaleapps, shoplytics). not widespread yet but SLA hits for enterprise.

oncall_jamie: no user-facing deploys from runtime in last 30m per deploy-bot. but infra team applied a kernel micropatch to the instance AMI ~40m ago (CVE backport, non-security config). flagging as potential.

eng_runtime_lee: copy. request to infra: can you confirm kernel version and if any eBPF or sockopt changes landed? @infra-team?

sre_maya: quick stats: p50 210ms, p90 360ms, p95 1.08s, p99 1.9s. error rate stable. CPU % per GPU host unchanged. network retransmits slight uptick.

eng_ml_ravi: are KV cache hit rates normal? if cache miss storm, could push seq lengths and cause slower kernels.

oncall_jamie: cache hit rate steady at 87%. not the immediate suspect.

eng_runtime_lee: grabbing tracing spans for a single slow trace. attaching top spans (from x-trace-id=trace-abc123):

```
// trace summary
span: http_receive 5ms
span: model_infer 890ms
span: kv_cache_lookup 3ms
span: gpu_io_wait 420ms
span: kernel_sched_delay 150ms
```

support_ana: customers reporting timeouts with front-end RT fallback, degraded UX. open ticket created.

oncall_jamie: running perf counters on a suspect host (i-0abcde). collecting 'perf stat -e cycles,instructions,cache-misses,context-switches -a sleep 30' now. will paste when done.

eng_runtime_lee: also run `sudo bpftrace -e 'tracepoint:sched:sched_switch { @[comm] = count(); }' -p 5` to see scheduling thrash.

sre_maya: copied perf output (30s window):

```
Performance counter stats for 'sleep 30':
  cycles: 24,100,123,456
  instructions: 12,050,067,890
  cache-misses: 1,200,345 (10%)
  context-switches: 48,300
```

sre_maya: context-switches look high relative to baseline (~12k). could be increased kernel preemption or timer tick rate.

eng_runtime_lee: that aligns with kernel_sched_delay in spans. if the patched kernel changed preemption model or high-res timers it could explain p95 jump.

support_ana: are we seeing region-level routing changes? Maybe some requests sent to degraded hosts only.

oncall_jamie: load balancer origin distribution uniform; but we have a pool of instances with the new AMI rolled to 40% of hosts in us-east-1. the p95 spike correlates with when rollout started (~37m ago).

eng_ml_ravi: hypothesis: kernel micropatch introduced more frequent scheduling churn causing GPU IO wait on inference threads, raising tail latency. alternate: also check TCP RTO/backoff since network retransmits ticked.

eng_runtime_lee: agree. mitigation plan: 1) pause AMI rollout, 2) shift traffic away from rolled hosts (canary pool) to unaffected hosts, 3) enable per-route fallback to smaller context model for impacted customers.

incident-bot: Action: rollout-paused by infra-team at 2211112380.

oncall_jamie: executing traffic shift now — moving 60% of traffic off canary pool into stable pool.

sre_maya: metrics updating: p95 dropping from 1.08s -> 420ms within 3mins after traffic shift. p99 still elevated on some traces.

support_ana: customer impact note: notified top 3 impacted customers with mitigation steps and ETA 30m. they acknowledged.

eng_runtime_lee: collecting dmesg and kernel taint logs from a rolled host:

```
[ 1120.234567] Kernel version: 5.15.0-abc+patch
[ 1120.234768] PREEMPT: preemptible: 1
[ 1120.234980] cgroup: perf_event: attaching events
[ 1120.235100] perf: interrupt took 1050us
```

eng_runtime_lee: the 'perf: interrupt took 1050us' entries weren't present on baseline hosts. suspicious.

sre_maya: pulling ftrace around timestamp of long-latency request — shows kernel irq handling delayed by ~700us and context-switch wake latency high.

eng_ml_ravi: can we reproduce on a staging device with the patched AMI? run a synthetic long sequence workload and compare p95 + perf.

noncall_jamie: creating a staging instance now with the new AMI, running load generator for 500 concurrent requests to /v1/generate seq_len=2048.

incident-bot: test job created job-id test-5581 at 2211113000.

sre_maya: staging run shows p95 ~1.2s, CPU softirq and scheduling wait spikes present.

eng_runtime_lee: confirmed reproduction. also ran `perf record -a -g -- sleep 10` and saw significant time in [kernel] irq_enter/irq_exit and schedule().

eng_runtime_lee: quick mitigation that helped in staging: toggling kernel parameter `kernel.sched_migration_cost_ns` back to baseline value reduced context-switches and p95.

oncall_jamie: can infra temporarily override that sysctl on rolled hosts?

eng_runtime_lee: yes — command: `sysctl -w kernel.sched_migration_cost_ns=500000` (example value). do this on canary hosts only.

incident-bot: sysctl-change executed on 8 hosts at 2211113322 by oncall_jamie.

sre_maya: after sysctl change, us-east-1 p95 down to 290ms, p99 ~480ms. CPU and context-switch graph back to normal.

support_ana: sending update to impacted customers: mitigation applied, continuing monitoring, will follow with RCA.

pm_kate: logging note: we should prepare customer-facing postmortem and include timeline, mitigation, and specific customers impacted. reference SLA windows.

eng_runtime_lee: next steps in-thread for RCA: collect full perf.data and perf report for representative hosts, attach flamegraphs, capture kernel config diff between baseline AMI and patched AMI, and ask infra for the exact kernel patch set.

eng_ml_ravi: I'll run a set of regression tests across different sequence lengths and models to quantify impact on per-token latency and effective throughput.

sre_maya: timeline so far:
- 2211112222: incident-bot pager fired
- 2211112240: oncall_jamie ack
- 2211112290: infra rollout began (~40% hosts)
- 2211112330: p95 started rising
- 2211112380: rollback/rollout paused
- 2211112420: traffic shifted off canary pool
- 2211113000: staging reproduction confirmed
- 2211113322: sysctl mitigation applied to canary hosts

noncall_jamie: tagging logs and traces with `incident/latency-221111` for post-incident search. use trace id prefix trace- for correlating.

eng_runtime_lee: hypothesis list (ranked):
1) kernel micropatch changed scheduler/timer behavior increasing context-switches -> GPU IO wait -> tail latency
2) altered softirq/interrupt latency path causing longer kernel interrupt handling
3) separate contributing factor: slight network retransmit increase due to tcp config change in patch
Testing needed: kernel diff, perf + ftrace on baseline vs patched, tcp retransmit counters, workload stress across seq lengths.

support_ana: customer impact summary ready for ops: 3 enterprise customers with degraded latency peaking at 1.9s p99, <0.1% requests timed out. no error rate increase.

pm_kate: let's schedule an RCA call at 2211114000 UTC with infra, runtime, SRE, and support. action items owner-assigned in this thread.

eng_runtime_lee: owner items I take: collect perf.data, flamegraphs, kernel symbol mapping, reproduce script.

sre_maya: I take: baseline metric extraction, time series for context-switches and softirq, and correlate trace IDs.

infra-team (via eng_runtime_lee): please provide: kernel patchset diffs, AMI rollout plan, and whether any eBPF or security modules were toggled.

support_ana: I'll prepare customer comms + tickets and append updates to the affected accounts.

incident-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. incident severity: Sev2 -> follow-up RCA.

oncall_jamie: wrapping this handoff — monitoring for 45min post-mitigation. leaving note for oncall-next. :white_check_mark:

eng_ml_ravi: note for RCA: include per-token cost delta if mitigation rolled back vs kept. might affect billing and sizing decisions.

sre_maya: saved logs/traces to s3://redwood-incidents/latency-221111/{perf,flamegraphs,traces}.

eng_runtime_lee: thanks all. will post RCA draft to #eng-postmortems and link here when ready.

support_ana: customers acknowledged the update and request to be CC'd on RCA.

pm_kate: adding executive summary for internal distribution after RCA.

incident-bot: thread closed for paging at 2211123456 (monitoring).
